section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study sample of women recruited in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia: an initial sample of 660 women, with 69 non-Malay/non-Chinese excluded, leaving 315 Malay women and 276 Chinese women. Reported group means include ages (Malay M = 42.96, Chinese M = 43.18) and BMIs (Malay M = 22.01, Chinese M = 22.33); all participants are described as women.
section_summary.evidence_source: Full Participants text: "The initial sample consisted of 660 women from Kuala Lumpur... Due to the small number of non-Malay and non-Chinese participants in the present study (n = 69), data from these participants were not analysed here. This left a sample of 315 Malay women (age M = 42.96, SD = 12.98, body mass index BMI M = 22.01, SD = 4.40)... The Chinese participants were 276 women (age M = 43.18, SD = 13.30, BMI M = 22.33, SD = 4.31)..."
